parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the Malayalam language module rules: mapped Rahul/Aarav to Arun/Jithin; localized Marathi to Malayalam; used 'samsaarikkan' (native verb stem) instead of 'speak cheyyuka'; used the person-sensitive 'tharum' for the first-person gift; avoided English-noun + Malayalam-case hybrids by using 'Malayalathil' and 'maasathil'; kept the taught English lines verbatim; and maintained the warm family register with proper honorifics.

violations.quote: Reels kandu time waste cheyyathe, divasavum just 15 minutes samsaarikkoo.
violations.why: It explicitly trashes Reels as a 'time waste' instead of using it as a neutral time-reallocation anchor.
violations.fix: Change to: 'Reels scroll cheyyunnathinu pakaram, divasavum just 15 minutes samsaarikkoo.' (Instead of scrolling Reels, just speak for 15 minutes daily.)

violations.why: The visual description includes a countdown timer, which is a prohibited misleading mechanic/fake UI element under Meta's ad policy.
violations.fix: Remove the countdown timer from the promotional graphic.

violations.quote: prominent '1' rupee offer, with the original '30' rupee price crossed out
violations.why: The visual description contains hard rupee pricing ('1' rupee offer, '30' rupee price) which is strictly prohibited unless approved by the team.
violations.fix: Remove the specific rupee pricing and replace it with a generic offer callout like 'Special Trial Offer'.

violations.why: The visual description contains a hard rupee price ('₹1') on the call-to-action button.
violations.fix: Change the button text to 'Start Trial' or 'Unlock Offer' without any rupee amount.

safety.summary: The ad contains severe violations regarding hard rupee pricing and a countdown timer in Scene 2, along with a moderate violation for trashing Reels in Scene 1.
